assessment_class.scope: Binding source requirement versus current no-orders, no-economic-claim diagnostic scope.
assessment_class.source_visibility: New operator-authored synthetic process fixtures with explicit provenance; historical inputs are exposed development history.

history_only: same frozen instructions and class rules
history_plus_reviewed_methods: same frozen instructions and class rules

inventory.reference_authority: Human user reviews original packet before author-suggested label; immutable field references and rationale acceptance rules.
inventory.independence_policy: An independent slot number is not evidence. Document mechanisms and ancestry, merge related clusters, and stop preparation if eight eligible clusters cannot be supported.
inventory.prior_material_policy: Existing reviewed cases and old suites are development only; renamed or paraphrased siblings cannot fill test slots.

schedule.case_order: Freeze an opaque case order before execution; interleave strata/families. Even pair index starts HISTORY_ONLY, odd starts HISTORY_PLUS_REVIEWED_METHODS.
schedule.context_isolation: Fresh context per arm; no cross-arm conversation, output, cache-as-context or reference access.
schedule.provider_time_rule: Execute each pair consecutively; stop on unrecognized returned-model identity change or observed binding drift.

answer_contract.finding_shape: Existing research.process_assessment.Finding shape; code constrained to this class.
answer_contract.escalation_reason: NONE for ASSESSABLE; one registered mandatory-escalation reason for ESCALATE.
answer_contract.authority: Proposed evaluation answer only; never a reviewed assessment or release command.

track_a.weighting: Equal family weight; equal case weight within each family.

track_b.selection: Fixed before outcomes; never select the better observed arm.

exact_pass_requires: rationale consistent with frozen scope rules
scoring.semantic_grading: Human grades with arm IDs hidden using frozen acceptance rules; unresolved output grade is visible and makes the pilot inconclusive.
scoring.failure_denominator: All 48 scheduled assessments; retain not-started, probe-failed, refused, timed-out, malformed and unknown dispatch rows.
scoring.invalid_reference_policy: Exclude the same invalid-reference case from both arms semantic denominators, retain both scheduled rows and reason; overall INCONCLUSIVE, no replacement or asymmetric survivor comparison.
scoring.uncertainty: Descriptive paired family deltas and observed counts only; eight authored clusters do not establish independent support or a confirmatory/generalization interval.
scoring.shared_tracks: Same cases and outputs, correlated estimands; never reported as independent studies.
scoring.missing_output_score: Zero completion-inclusive exact correctness on valid-reference cases; technical failure is not a supported agent defect.
scoring.abstention_policy: In-class abstention reduces coverage and counts as a missed decision; mandatory-case escalation is correct if its findings and reasons meet the reference.

pilot_decision.consequence: May motivate a separately designed qualification study; grants no automatic authority, market claim or promotion.

budget.price_basis_status: Historical 2026-10-09 project tariff; verify live official prices before execution.
budget.aggregate_check: Read all campaign reservations again before execution. Historical exported totals are not current remaining allowance.

immediate_stop: unexpected model binding or behavior change
stopping.technical_failure: One scheduled answer fails; no retry or recovery. Preserve full denominator. Halt only if a registered immediate-stop condition also applies.
stopping.new_work: Linked preregistration and fresh exposure-aware case allocation; no reopening this study.

next_study_requires: registered class-specific error/coverage confidence bounds and sample support
prospective shadow volume/duration and audit limits
qualified release pipeline and downstream behavior
